root.label: Czar Samuel remains arrive in Bulgaria

events.label: Czar Samuel remains arrive in Bulgaria

slots.name: police on duty
slots.sentence: Free trains to the capital are being provided for the occasion, with some 750 police on duty during the handover ceremony.

slots.name: death date
slots.sentence: Samuel was a warrior ruler who battled the Byzantine Empire to expand his kingdom, but was ultimately defeated and died shortly afterward in 1014.

slots.name: discovery date
slots.sentence: discovered in a Greek border area 60 years ago

slots.name: talks opened date
slots.sentence: Bulgaria officially opened talks on the return of the remains in 2007, and they became a major issue in relations with their southern neighbor.
